_comment: Pages and responses the Paradox panel gives to the bridge, and what src/api/status.js and src/api/alarm.js make of them. "page" / "response.body" is an inline string or {"file": "<path relative to tests/>"}. Result arrays: {"empty_slots": n} stands for a JavaScript new Array(n), n unset slots (a port may use a list of None). "error" is the exact message of the failure; messages other than the parse error come from the JavaScript HTTP client (axios 0.18) and only the fact of failing is portable. Rows with a known_bug (catalog in README.md) are in known_bugs/status_pages.json, in the same groups.
